"""在明确登录前置条件后才能接入设备运行。"""
import os

import pytest

from autotest.mobile.profile_screen import ProfileScreen

pytestmark = pytest.mark.app


@pytest.mark.case(id='AUTHOR-PROFILE', purpose='个人资料展示', expected='显示已明确的当前用户姓名', basis="requirement", source="requirement")
def test_profile_name(app_driver):
    screen = ProfileScreen(app_driver)
    screen.open()
    assert screen.display_name() == os.environ["APP_EXPECTED_NAME"]
